input: Sync my doctor's records to a new practice

gold.taskTitle: Transfer Medical Records to a New Practice
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to move their medical records from their current doctor or practice to a new one.

questions.title: Which practice or doctor are you transferring records from?
questions.description: Identify the current or previous medical practice that holds the records.

questions.title: Have you already chosen your new practice or doctor?
questions.description: Determine whether the destination practice is confirmed or still being decided.

questions.title: What types of records need to be transferred?
questions.description: Clarify the scope of records, such as full history, lab results, imaging, prescriptions, or vaccination records.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which the transfer must be complete?
questions.description: Understand any time pressure, such as an upcoming appointment at the new practice.

questions.title: Do you know if your current practice uses an online patient portal?
questions.description: Determine whether records can be accessed or requested digitally, speeding up the process.

questions.title: Are these records for yourself or someone else you care for?
questions.description: Establish whether the user is acting on their own behalf or as a guardian or caregiver.

questions.title: Do you need the records in a specific format, such as digital or paper?
questions.description: Find out if the new practice has a preferred format for receiving transferred records.
